name: Vermilion Orbit
motif: A large vermilion disc offset against a slim charcoal rectangle, a small cobalt circle, and one precise ivory arc. Powerful asymmetric balance.

name: Blue Assembly
motif: Three interlocking cobalt and sky-blue geometric cube-like planes with one tiny vermilion square. Clever spatial puzzle, flat printed shapes rather than a 3D render.

name: Ochre Fold
motif: An abstract folded-paper construction in mustard yellow, warm ochre and charcoal, with a coral red disc. Bold sharp-edged angular planes.

name: Quiet Current
motif: Three wide sweeping indigo and turquoise ribbon-like curves, a small vermilion circle and generous warm ivory space. Abstract movement, no traditional wave illustration.

name: Signal Garden
motif: A playful modular arrangement of mint green stems, raspberry red circles and mustard yellow semicircles. Abstract graphic rhythm, restrained and precise.

name: Night Geometry
motif: Deep charcoal background, a large warm ivory circle, electric cobalt triangular plane and small vermilion square, quietly dramatic modernist composition. Upper 23 percent is uninterrupted charcoal for light title lettering to be added later.

name: Coral Steps
motif: Offset stair-step blocks and rectangles in coral red, brick red and muted teal, on warm ivory, an unexpected tiny black circle. Architectural rhythm.

name: Red Lantern
motif: An abstract oversized vermilion oval split by a slim charcoal vertical line, one indigo rectangle and small warm ochre disc. Modern typographic-poster-like geometry suggesting a lantern without illustrating one.

name: Offset Grid
motif: An inventive off-centre lattice of thick charcoal lines, with a few large cobalt blue and mustard yellow modules shifted outside the grid. Strong negative space and optical puzzle.

name: Mint Balance
motif: A pale mint field, a floating charcoal ellipse, a warm ivory rounded square and a small vermilion disc in a beautiful carefully balanced asymmetrical arrangement. Upper 23 percent is quiet pale mint for dark title lettering to be added later.
